name: Cash Deposit 1
definition: Deposit of an amount of money defined in cash notes and/or coins.

NoteDenomination.name: Note Denomination
NoteDenomination.definition: Specifies the note or coin denomination, including the currency, such as a 50 euro note.

NumberOfNotes.name: Number Of Notes
NumberOfNotes.definition: Specifies the number of notes of the same denomination in the deposit.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Specifies the total amount of money in the cash deposit, that is the note denomination times the number of notes.
